scientific_integrity: An analytic proof and independent exact finite checks are supplied; no external verification or certification is claimed. Single-trie mean formula and Mellin oscillation are attributed to Mahmoud and Ward.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number of independent fair-bit binary Patricia tries; priority comparison remains open for any unlocated older simultaneous-pattern theorem. The source date is from a dated 2010 arXiv source; an earlier 2008 journal issue has only a month-level public date available, so no precise day is assigned to it.
title: A log-periodic Poisson law for cherries shared by independent binary tries
